notes.title: CRYMACHINA - PC Features & Launch Week Discount
notes.notes:
[h1]About the Game[/h1]

What does it mean to be human? The truth behind the fall of mankind awaits you in the bleak world of [i]CRYMACHINA[/i]!

This sci-fi inspired action RPG unites fast-paced combat with dark, striking visuals and follows the story of three E.V.E. (the recreated psyches of deceased humans instilled in synthetic bodies) as they seek their full-fledged humanity.

Utilize the full potential of your newly-granted robotic form by outfitting it with a myriad of equipment, including melee, ranged, and shoulder-mounted weapons. Enhance and augment your weapons to add powerful effects to each strike, and rip apart enemies with fiery combos and special skills.

[h1]PC Features[/h1]

Read on to learn about the features and enhancements that were implemented into this release of [i]CRYMACHINA[/i].

[h2]4K Resolution and High Frame Rate[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43724914/187f47354c3cc30baf6eb6c5bb73e7713b31fd5e.png[/img]

Explore Eden in stunning UHD and arbitrarily high frame rates, depending on your hardware.

[h2]Keyboard and Mouse Control Support[/h2]
The keyboard and mouse can be used to play [i]CRYMACHINA[/i] as effectively as with a controller to complement any preferred gameplay set up, from playing at your desk to the flexibility offered by a PC paired with your TV, remote play, or handheld PCs! This release includes precise mouse camera control and the ability to interact with menus using the mouse and keyboard.

[h2]Additional Graphics Options[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43724914/97c1a70b1bc27735132aa2c8a4a0990b567fa458.png[/img]

Advanced graphics settings can be used to optimize your experience for your particular hardware setup.

[h2]Arbitrary Aspect Ratio: Steam Deck & Ultrawide Support[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43724914/e8b443b01c21ce02bed525e19280d652cebd833a.jpg[/img]

The game scales to various aspect ratios. This has been tested from 21:9 to 4:3, but should also work well on any display in between, including the venerable Steam Deck’s 16:10 display.

Dive into the world of [i]CRYMACHINA[/i] by visiting the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2258500/CRYMACHINA/]Steam page[/url], and take advantage of our special launch discount on the Ultimate Edition from now until [b]October 30[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43724914/a67ecef527910d0f8195e2c742d8196fd02a9b12.png[/img]

Thanks for reading!
